findings.evidence: The unchanged view does not explicitly print E!=0. Its electric-force-direction comparison presupposes nonzero force; this is an inferred operative domain, not an explicit printed source condition. Author source_solution says smaller mean displacement and its B rationale makes the long-time comparison, but neither explicitly adds zero-field strict inequality. They are compared only on the frozen domain, not used to expand it. At E=0 the axis is undefined and both field-driven displacements are zero, so strict inequality and nonzero higher-order differences must not be extended there.
